g.text: Treat others as you would like to be treated.
THE ONE RULE SHARED BY EVERY FAITH AND CULTURE ON EARTH

text.font-family: 'PingFang SC','Heiti SC','Hiragino Sans','SF Arabic','DecoType Naskh','Devanagari MT','Avenir Next','Helvetica Neue',sans-serif

g.text: 己所不欲，勿施于人 · أحب لأخيك ما تحب لنفسك · दूसरों के साथ वैसा ही करो जैसा तुम चाहते हो · Trata a los demás como quieres ser tratado
